verdict.rationale: Exa is API-first. Search, Contents, Agent and Websets are all documented as APIs, and the Websets Dashboard is described as a no-code visual alternative to the same API, with results delivered via 'dashboard, API, or webhooks'. A Team Management API also exists alongside the public API, but no doc states full UI/API parity, and account functions like credits, auto-recharge, invoices and per-key limits are not shown to be API-accessible. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, documented API coverage of billing/credits and key-limit management, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can also build websets visually in the [Dashboard](/docs/websets/dashboard/get-started), no code required.
Results arrive asynchronously through the dashboard, API, or webhooks.
Download the OpenAPI specs for the Exa public API and Team Management API in YAML or JSON.
Exa Agent is an async, usage-based web research agent API for high-compute tasks like list building, enrichment, and deep research.
